footer.blurb: The marketplace for trusted local services. Find, book and pay in one place.

home.heroTitle: Hire someone who knows the work, at the price you see.
home.heroSubtitle: Plumbers, electricians, cleaning, beauty and more. Verified providers in Maputo, with the price and the duration fixed before you book.
home.categoriesBlurb: Pick a trade to see who works in it.
home.servicesBlurb: Fixed price and duration. Book, and the amount does not change on the way.
home.providersBlurb: Identity and documents checked by Ntizo. Rated by the people who hired them.
home.storiesBlurb: Real reviews, from bookings made through Ntizo.
home.bandTitle: Work for yourself? Set your price and leave the calendar to us.
home.bandBody: List your services at the price and duration you set. Ntizo brings the customers, handles the booking and the M-Pesa payment, and keeps a fixed percentage you see before you publish.
home.factPriceBody: The customer pays exactly what you set.
home.factAgendaBody: Bookings land only in the hours you open.
